title: Pregnancy Weight Gain Tracker
description: IOM guideline weight-gain ranges by pre-pregnancy BMI, plus a weight log chart.
howto: Enter your height and pre-pregnancy weight to get your BMI and IOM recommended gain range.
Log weigh-ins with date and weight.
See each entry's total gain and whether it is inside the recommended range.
View the chart of your gain against the guideline band.

faqs.a: Underweight (BMI <18.5): 12.5-18 kg; normal (18.5-24.9): 11.5-16 kg; overweight (25-29.9): 7-11.5 kg; obese (30+): 5-9 kg total gain.
In your browser's localStorage. Nothing is uploaded.
No. These are general guidelines; your provider may set a different target for you.
